name: Brago's sword
description: The ghost king's sword, left behind when he dies; Adriana takes it and wields it as a symbol.

timeline.summary: Adriana attacks Kaya with Brago's sword, but Kaya turns phantom and grins at her shock.
timeline.quote: In an instant the assassin's stomach turned a bizarre and translucent violet

timeline.summary: Adriana takes up Brago's sword, deciding it is safest in her hands.
timeline.quote: Adriana's fingers grazed the hilt of Brago's sword.

timeline.summary: Adriana declares she carries Brago's sword and, though stripped of her title, will not relinquish her duty to defend the city from the usurper.
timeline.quote: I know this because I now carry that sword

pages_say.description: The ghost king's sword, left behind when he dies; Adriana takes it and wields it as a symbol.
The blade bearing the symbol of the city on its pommel, which Adriana now carries.
